text: Brent rose about 0.7% to $114.68 after Houthis claimed a missile strike on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery; it briefly traded near $116 overnight.
Gold slipped about 0.5% to roughly $4,038 overnight as higher oil revived inflation worries before the Fed decision.
Silver also edged lower but morning quotes disagree (about $53.70 to $54.70), so the silver price and gold/silver ratio are left blank this update.
Junior miners had a strong Tuesday: GDXJ closed up 3.5% at $103.43, ahead of GDX's 2.7%.
Treasury yields ticked up before the decision: the 10-year near 5.01% and the 2-year near 4.75%.
Stock futures were mixed: Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.3–0.4% after SK Hynix's record profit, Dow futures lower. Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close.
SQQQ closed Tuesday down 3.8% at $36.93, the mirror of QQQ's 1.3% gain.
Bitcoin climbed to about $81,400, up more than 2% over 24 hours ahead of the Fed.
